q: Also, I slept comfortably each night because I ___ tired after a hard day's work, and it did not matter if I was sleeping on a bed or on the hard floor.
explanation: would는 과거의 반복적 행동이나 습관을 나타내는 조동사(~하곤 했다)로 쓰였다. 원문: "Also, I slept comfortably each night because I would be tired after a hard day's work, and it did not matter if I was sleeping on a bed or on the hard floor."

q: I ate only when I was hungry, so even a simple meal ___."
explanation: 'taste+형용사'는 '~한 맛이 나다'라는 뜻의 2형식 구조이므로 부사가 아닌 형용사 great이 쓰이며, 과거시제 tasted가 맞다. 원문: "I ate only when I was hungry, so even a simple meal tasted great."

q: "Spend money like a rich man?" ___ Puneet.
explanation: 앞뒤 문맥이 모두 과거시제로 서술되는 이야기이므로 continue의 과거형 continued가 쓰인다. 원문: "'Spend money like a rich man?' continued Puneet."

q: "A rich man knows how to make money ___.
explanation: 'make+목적어+동사원형'은 '~가 …하게 만들다'라는 뜻으로 목적격보어에 동사원형이 오며, how to+동사원형은 '~하는 방법'을 뜻한다. 원문: "'A rich man knows how to make money grow."

q: So, I tried to spend money on something ___ bring me back more money rather than on luxurious things.
explanation: 선행사 something(사물)을 받으며 관계사절에서 주어 역할을 하는 주격 관계대명사 that이 쓰였다. 원문: "So, I tried to spend money on something that would bring me back more money rather than on luxurious things."

q: For me, it was this wisdom that our father ___."
explanation: 'try+to부정사'는 '~하려고 노력하다'라는 뜻이며, try+동명사(try explaining)는 '시험 삼아 ~해보다'라는 다른 의미이므로 구별해야 한다. 원문: "For me, it was this wisdom that our father tried to explain."

q: Now Puru realized how foolish he ___.
explanation: 'had+과거분사' 형태의 과거완료시제로, 깨달은 시점(과거)보다 더 이전의 일을 나타낸다. 원문: "Now Puru realized how foolish he had been."
'with ~ in mind'는 '~을 마음에 새기고, ~을 고려하여'라는 뜻의 관용 표현이다. 원문: "With this wisdom in mind, Puru started a new life."
